subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should Kova diagnostics introduce a dedicated focused OpenClaw prepack profile, and which layer owns that profile and its omission contract?
rationale: Source inspection confirms adjacent performance optimizations but not the requested packaging contract; choosing omitted contents and whether Kova, OCM, or OpenClaw owns the profile requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Specify focused profile
options.body: Define a release-shaped allowlist or omission contract, benchmark it against full prepack, and implement the profile at the packaging-owning layer.

options.title: Keep full prepack
options.body: Retain the existing release-shaped packaging path when diagnostic fidelity is more important than the unquantified performance gain.

options.title: Move upstream
options.body: Track the profile in OpenClaw or OCM if Kova should only select a stable packaging interface rather than define package contents.

recommendation.title: Specify focused profile
recommendation.body: Define a release-shaped allowlist or omission contract, benchmark it against full prepack, and implement the profile at the packaging-owning layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue, are its assignee, and carried the closest merged performance work.
